goal: Log in using the username supplied as a run parameter named 'username' together with the app's stored password, then read the green confirmation message shown in the secure area. Record 'username' as a typed input parameter so a caller can pass a different one. The login form rejects an unknown username with a red flash message reading 'Your username is invalid!' — declare that as a business outcome so a caller gets a typed answer rather than a failure.

input.description: Logs into the Heroku 'The Internet' app secure area using a caller-supplied username and the app's stored password, returning the green confirmation message. Declares the INVALID_USERNAME business outcome when the username is not recognized.

outputs.name: confirmation_message
outputs.description: The green flash confirmation message shown after successful login to the secure area
